title: fix(plugin-grid): a list row whose click opens nothing draws no record link and no Open item

Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:列表里点了不会打开任何东西的行(视图写了 `navigation.mode: 'none'`,或只开放 `list` 的对象),表格第一列不再画成链接(没有链接颜色、下划线、锚点或链接角色),右键菜单也不再出现「打开」和「在新标签页打开」;行操作(如 Revoke)照旧。对象列表、对象数据页、界面列表页三处都生效。
- 为什么改:这些行点了没有任何反应,但看起来可以点,用户会以为页面坏了。
- 风险与回滚:表格和列表视图各多一个可选的宿主属性 `rowOpensRecord`,不传时行为与之前完全一样,其他宿主不受影响;能打开记录的行(抽屉、页面)不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridLinkCell.tsx` 的 `opens === false` 分支;`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` 的 `renderRowContextMenu` 里 `rowOpensRecord` 两处;`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` 的 `rowOpensRecord: navOverlay.mode !== 'none'`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.rowOpensNothing-33317.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.rowOpensNothing-33317.test.tsx`,预期 9 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Measured on `origin/main` `f068cde8` (#33441 included), through the real `ObjectView` → `ListView` → `ObjectGrid`.** The console hosts always hand `ListView` an `onRowClick`, and `ListView` always hands the grid `onRowClick: navigation.handleClick`, so the grid could not tell a row that opens nothing from one that opens a drawer. Two lines decided the face:

- the record-link cell: `objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx` wraps the first column (and any `link: true` column) in `LinkCell` unconditionally, and `RecordLink` in `objectGridLinkCell.tsx` draws `a href` when the host publishes a record URL, else `span role="link"`. Measured: a view authored `navigation: { mode: 'none' }` on a served object draws the **anchor** (the host's `recordHref` answers); a list-only object draws the `span role="link"` with `data-testid="primary-field-link"` (its `recordHref` answers `null`).
- the right-click Open: `renderRowContextMenu` in `ObjectGrid.tsx` reads `const opens = !!onRowClick || (navigation.mode !== 'none' && ...)`, so any host handler means Open. Measured: authored `none` offers `row-context-open` and `row-context-open-new-tab`; list-only offers `row-context-open`.

The fix, the narrowest signal the order allowed: the grid cannot derive it from props it already receives (the console's resolved mode never reaches it; the grid branch of `ListView` forwards no `navigation`), so one optional prop carries it, absent = today's behaviour.

- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid`**: `ObjectGridComponentProps.rowOpensRecord?: boolean`. `false` ⇒ `LinkCell` (new internal `opens` prop) draws the value in a plain `span` with the link's clamp and width only (no anchor, no `role`, no handler of its own, so its click falls through to the row), and `renderRowContextMenu` offers neither Open nor Open in new tab. Row actions, the actions column and #33441's inline fold are untouched.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-list`**: `ListViewProps.rowOpensRecord?: boolean`, forwarded to the grid only, on the grid's host channel beside `recordLinkAdornment` (only when defined).
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`** (ships in `@object-ui/console`): `ObjectView` passes `navOverlay.mode !== 'none'` (the resolved mode: `none` for authored `none` and for a list-only object via `servesRecordRead`) through `useObjectViewListRenderer`; `ObjectDataPage` passes `recordServed`; `InterfaceListPage` passes `recordAction !== 'none'`. `onRowClick` is passed exactly as before.
- **Docs**: `rowOpensRecord` sections in `ui/packages/plugin-grid/README.md`, `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` and `ui/packages/plugin-list/README.md`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/33317-row-opens-nothing-plain.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console` patch, both declaration lines.

Not changed: `packages/spec`, any server package, `onRowClick` routing, row actions.

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.rowOpensNothing-33317.test.tsx`, real `ObjectView` + `ListView` grid + `MePermissionsProvider`, one differential per case (same object and rows; only the view's `navigation` or the served operations differ). The right-click menu is opened by a `contextmenu` event on a plain cell.

- authored `navigation.mode: none`: the name cell holds no `a[href]` and no `[role="link"]`, no `primary-field-link`; the menu has no Open items and keeps Revoke.
- authored `none`: a ⌘-click on a plain cell still reaches the host (one `window.open`), and a ⌘-click on the now-plain name cell reaches the row too (a second one).
- list-only object: same as the first case.
- CONTROL, default drawer: the name cell is the record link, the menu offers Open and Open in new tab and Revoke.
- CONTROL, authored `page`: the name cell is the link, the menu offers Open.
- data page, list-only: the name cell is plain; CONTROL served: it is the link.

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.rowOpensNothing-33317.test.tsx`, real `InterfaceListPage` + `ListView` grid: `recordAction: 'none'` → plain name cell; CONTROL default drawer → link.

**Red-first (the measurement):** the eight production files restored to base `f068cde8` (0 differ from base after restore), the new pins kept.

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-② measured `yes (widening)`.** The order allowed a new optional prop when the grid cannot derive the signal; it needed one on `ObjectGrid` and one on `ListView` (the hop between the console and the grid), both published, both optional, absent = unchanged. The claim started at `no`; the seat amends it.
- **File surface.** `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (forwarding only) and three docs files are outside the claim's named files; they are the props that carry the signal to the grid, and the docs-driven rule in `ui/AGENTS.md` (Coding Standards, rule 2) asks for the README and docs page.
- **⌘-click on an authored `none` row still opens a new tab.** That is `useNavigationOverlay`'s modifier-click rule ("regardless of the configured navigation mode"), reached through the host's `onRowClick`; the order says not to break what the host routes through it, so it stays, and the pin holds it. The menu's "Open in new tab" is gone for such a row, so the two now differ; a list-only row opens no tab either way.
- **Other faces of the same rows, not changed here:** the phone card face (below 768 px) still draws the card as a tap target, and the gallery and board cards of a `none` list keep their pointer; only the grid is handed `rowOpensRecord`. Observed by reading, not measured; noted, not filed.
- **`preventNavigation` on the console object list:** the console's `handleRowClick` writes `?recordId=` for a `drawer` view without reading `preventNavigation`, so `rowOpensRecord` is keyed to the resolved mode only. Observed by reading, not measured; noted, not filed.
- **Lint:** `eslint` on the touched files: 0 errors; the `ListView` forwarding line adds one `react-hooks/refs` warning of the same shape its three sibling `viewComponentSchema.type === 'object-grid'` lines already carry.
